description: This file initializes a React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the root rendering context and wraps the App component within React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering a React application into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
